finding_titles: 'collab'/'colab'/misspelled 'colaborate' used as a verb is turned into the product name, and the Collaborate guide then serves a wrong verified answer
A physical 'collab room' is corrected to 'Collaborate room' and a non-system question gets a verified Collaborate guide answer
Distance-2 correction turns another real product (Blackbaud) into Blackboard and serves the Blackboard access procedure
The D-114 organizational guard covers only 'where' asks with a fixed place-noun list, so office, team and role asks are treated as software and lose their Institutional handoff
The corrected question text, not the typed text, is stored in served result items and sub-questions

Contrast-modifier tolerance drops the predicate of yes/no questions ('required', 'available', 'optional'), so obligation and availability questions get unrelated 'can' sentences, including policy-type questions
Contrast tolerance drops a marked modifier the guide states itself or never mentions ('group', 'midterm'), flipping the guide's own exception
The -ment/-tion/-sion derivation root conflates LMS object nouns with unrelated verbs (discussion and discuss, assignment and assign)
The container rule binds 'course' when it owns the asked object ('the title of my Blackboard course'), so a gradebook-item limit answers a course question
The synonym groups plus the extended SAME_ACTION let 'remove (image)' answer 'delete (course)'
_NON_CRITICAL removes scope restrictors ('specific', 'particular', 'certain', 'exact') and 'once' became a stop word, so per-student questions get whole-class answers
D-114 promises a cut unit is never served, but statement units that start or end mid-sentence are still served
Contrast-modifier tolerance ignores the word's role: 'required'/'available'/'group' dropped when they ARE the asked predicate or object, serving wrong answers
A silent guide is treated as general: 'midterm' (and 'final') tolerated when the guide names neither side, so a midterm ask gets the final-grade procedure
Container rule treats destination/source prepositions ('to/into/for/from my Blackboard course') as a locator and drops 'course', serving answers for a different action target
Synonym groups widen term coverage, but 'modify'/'pick'/'display'/'begin' are not in ACTION_VERBS, so the heading-action mismatch guard is skipped for them
'once'/'until' made stop words but not mapped into the before/after polarity guard, so a 'once' ask is answered by a 'before' statement
Physical/organizational guard applies only to LOCATION intent: physical asks phrased as procedure, yes/no or selection bind to a guide and lose their Institutional handoff
Mixed-procedure end detection misses dash-lettered next sections ('B- ...'), so section A is served with section B's steps
System-name corrector rewrites real English words and physical 'collab rooms' into product names
Non-critical list drops meaning-bearing qualifiers such as 'current' (grade) and 'specific' (students)
Claim-level conflict isolation now serves units of the journal-stamped chunks, which the registry record says must not be served
Contrast-modifier tolerance drops BOTH sides when a guide names neither, so the grade-transfer procedure is served for "midterm", "group" and "optional" grades
"until"/"once" were made stop words but the new polarity guard only knows before/after, so opposite-condition statements are now served for "until" asks
-ment/-tion derivation root lets any "assign/assigned" state "assignment" (and depart/department, except/exception, select/selection), so irrelevant units are served
No measured generalisation: PF-5B changes zero served outcomes on the fresh set while it gained only on the PF-4 diagnostic wording
Several list entries appear only in fresh-set wording, and the lists were written after the fresh set was frozen in the same session
_NON_CRITICAL removes meaning-bearing restrictors unconditionally (specific, particular, certain, whole, entire, already, quick)
Claim-level conflict isolation is fitted to the one count-type conflict and reads topic words from an internal identifier
Case-specific carve-out in the physical-place regex for "Grade Center", a page name no enabled guide prints
NOT_TYPOS is hand-curated: most entries can never be reached
adversarial_review.resolution: every reproduced issue fixed by refusing more (rules removed or narrowed); no rule widened in response

worst_case_differential.method: PF-4 (HEAD) versus final PF-5B select_answer with every chunk of each named guide retrieved, over the P0, P1, PF-4 held-out, wrong-source and reviewer probe questions (fresh set excluded)
